description: Wall time in seconds for 5000 operations through reactor-direct.ts, per auth ladder rung. Each set was run interleaved (one repetition of every level, then the next) so host drift is common-mode within a repetition rather than aliased onto whichever level ran while the machine was busy.
caveats: PGlite is single-threaded WASM on the host loop, so the pg_advisory_xact_lock over the read set does not behave as it does on Postgres.
Nothing is backdated, so foldEvaluatedScope never runs and L4 is understated.
No group principals are in the policy, so the groups projection reads no streams and L3 is understated.
Batch size 100 amortises one waitForJob poll across 100 actions. At batch size 1 the 10ms poll quantum swamps every effect.

sets.name: L3 measured in its own batch, retained as the blocked-ordering artifact
